name: polish-open-source-prose
description: Edit open-source prose without rewriting clear text, changing protected content, or inventing facts.

interface.shortDescription: Edit open-source prose without losing facts or voice.
interface.longDescription: Revise public project prose without rewriting text that is already clear, changing facts, commands, quotations, or the author's voice, or adding facts the author did not provide. Includes a Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) locale layer.
defaultPrompt: Audit this README and propose only evidence-backed edits.
Localize this project prose for zh-Hant-TW without changing facts.
Recommend a provenance method for this technical article.
